title: Sam language - Wikipedia
text: Sam language ... Sam, or Songum, is a Madang language spoken in Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. It is spoken in Songum ( 5.50779°S 145.851042°E), Buan, and Wongbe villages in Astrolabe Bay Rural LLG. [1][2] 'Sam' is the word for 'language'. 'Songum' is a village name.

text: The music of Papua New Guinea encompasses a wide range of traditional and contemporary styles developed across the country's highly diverse ethnic groups. Traditional celebrations known as sing-sing feature communal song and dance, and form a central part of cultural life.

text: Sam is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Trans-New Guinea language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
